## 4. Fixed canon and open space

Four students are away on the last-breath walk and six remain. The Teacher repeats the water-cycle lesson, the Feral Orphan compares it to the light, and the Naive Son changes from asking what his mother “is” to what she “would have” said. The Teacher does not explain that shift. Do not name a cause, loss, or mission outcome.
